description: EXPERIMENTAL. Needs iPhone Mirroring and a python3 with pyobjc. Refused with mirror_not_live or mirror_state_unknown when the mirror is not live or its state cannot be confirmed. Open an app: Home Screen, Spotlight via the menu, clear, type the name (the clipboard keeps it), then tap only an exact label inside the Spotlight Top Hit card (suggestion, website and Settings rows of the same name are ignored, so a name the Top Hit card does not show is app not found; reads the English "Top Hit" label unless NORACU_TOPHIT_LABELS names the phone's own; a pasted name that never shows up in Spotlight, even after up to 15 s, is open_not_confirmed — retry); confirms the app opened (frame diff + OCR), taps the Top Hit icon when the label tap does nothing, else open_not_confirmed, back on the Home Screen. Reports delivery and retry.
name: phone_open
